scientific_integrity: The all-size theorem is proved by an exact type bijection, coefficient-level triangular inversion, and explicit universal sharpness witnesses. Enumeration is supplementary and does not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Known number of named parameters; base must be a disjoint union of positive-length chains; identifies chain length multiset only; no extension to arbitrary finite posets; historical priority provisional; no independent audit.
title: Sharp half-grade reconstruction of disjoint-chain parameter posets from singleton type counts
